subject: Urgent: Pilot keep-alive request — 10-day buffer for Corelytics connector rewrite
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex@corelytics.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Corelytics Procurement <procurement@corelytics.io>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot stalling — need short keep-alive while connector is rewritten

Hi Ben,

Quick summary — our engineering lead found a blocking regression in the Postgres adapter we were using to sync training data. The team has to pull a small refactor (affects schema parsing and incremental sync) and that pushes our demo & validation by ~2 weeks.

Given the timeline, we9re worried about losing the pilot momentum — stakeholders want to see the Redwood inference results in production logs before the quarter close. Can you help with a short pilot keep-alive (extra 10 days of sandbox / reduced-cost tokens) and prioritize any provisioning help that keeps our test harness running?

I attached the error trace and a brief milestone plan. We9re happy to sign a short amendment if needed.

What I need from you:
- confirmation we can get a 10-day buffer on the current pilot (sandbox capacity + some token credit)
- any ops suggestions to reduce the integration pain (we9re hitting a KV cache mismatch on large sequences)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we9re aligned on a demo during the week of Sep 14 but need a stable staging window to finish.

Thanks,
Alex Monroe
Head of Integrations, Corelytics
---
Attachments: error-trace-connector-20260829.log, corelytics-milestone-plan.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@corelytics.io>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot stalling — need short keep-alive while connector is rewritten

Alex —

Thanks for the note and the logs. Sorry to hear about the adapter regression; that type of schema parsing issue can definitely derail a demo. I9ve looped in our onboarding lead (Marissa) and an infra engineer (Dev) to assess the attachment and see whether a config tweak or a temporary proxy can buy you time.

From a commercial standpoint I can escalate a 10-day pilot buffer plus 50k sandbox tokens for validation to our pilot approvals team. To move quickly, can you confirm:
1) preferred start/end dates for the 10-day extension
2) whether the extra tokens should be applied to the existing sandbox or to a new isolated sandbox (you mentioned sensitive logs)
3) a brief acceptance criteria for the demo (what counts as 9success9 so I can include it in the approval)

If you9re comfortable with our standard makegood agreement I9ll include a conditional clause (extension granted if engineering certifies the blocking error is being addressed and no further regressions are discovered in a 48-hour smoke period).

I9ll follow up internally immediately.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot stalling — Corelytics request: 10-day keep-alive + tokens (urgent)

Marissa / Dev — forwarding Corelytics ask. TL;DR: integration regression blocking demo; they9re requesting a 10-day pilot buffer and ~50k sandbox tokens to finish validation. Attachments include error trace and milestone plan.

Can you confirm feasibility and any operational options (e.g., temp proxy, whitelist for longer KV cache, or an isolated sandbox) + whether we can approve the requested token amount under our pilot policy? If we can9t grant the full token amount, what reduced offer would still keep the momentum (maybe environment hours + 10k tokens)?

Notes for approvals:
- Deal: DL-2026-0179 (Corelytics) — sales-led pilot, legal ok with short amendments.
- Risk: low — no prod data, pilot environment only.
- Recommendation sought: conditional 10-day extension with a smoke-test clause.

Dev: can you review the log (attached in original) and advise whether a quick config shim is feasible? If we can fix it without spinning a new sandbox, that9s preferable.

Marissa: can you own the commercial approval thread and confirm token uplift / amendment language? I can help draft the email to procurement.

Thanks — need a reply today if possible.

-Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@corelytics.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Corelytics Procurement <procurement@corelytics.io>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot stalling — Pilot keep-alive request approved (conditional)

Alex —

Thanks for the details and the timeline. We9ve reviewed the attachment and spoken with engineering. Summary of what we can approve immediately:

1) A conditional 10-day pilot keep-alive for Corelytics starting 2026-09-03 and ending 2026-09-12.
2) Sandbox token uplift: 35,000 validation tokens applied to your existing sandbox (we can move them to a new isolated sandbox if you confirm the environment must be segregated).
3) Conditions: a) engineering must provide a remediation plan with milestones within 48 hours of Sept 3, b) we9ll run a 48-hour smoke window once the fix is applied; if further regressions are discovered we may pause additional uplift pending mitigation.
4) We will prepare a short amendment (one-page) documenting dates and token uplift; Procurement, please review and advise any PO requirements. DocuSign link will be shared by EOD Sep 3 if you accept the terms.

Dev Patel notes that a short-lived proxy and a small config tweak (KV cache limit increase) should reduce the immediate pain while the connector rewrite completes. Dev, please add any ops steps and a ETA in the amendment.

Alex, please confirm you accept the conditional terms and whether to apply tokens to the existing sandbox or a new isolated environment. Once you confirm we9ll circulate the amendment and DocuSign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
